blocks.text: Thank you for the first set of files for the {{fact:f:E-2017-001.client}} reserve adequacy review. They came through last week, and David has now loaded both the reserve detail and the year-end figures, so this seemed the right moment to start a single thread for our questions about the data. Jennifer and David are copied, so whoever on our side is closest to a question can pick it up.

For the most part the two agree well, but there is one thing we would like your team's help with. A small group of records appears twice in the reserve detail, with the same identifiers and the same reserve amounts, and the only difference between the two copies is the date the extract was run. Our best guess is that the extract was run twice and both runs ended up in the file, in which case each pair is really one record and the detail, as it stands, counts those reserves twice.

If we do not hear otherwise, we will treat each pair as a single record, keep one copy, and note that in our working papers as an assumption we made rather than something the data told us. We would much prefer to know for certain, though, since it affects the figure we reconcile to. What we need next is a word from whoever runs the extract on whether it was run more than once.
